passive.name: Skaarl, the Cowardly Lizard
passive.desc: Kled rides his trusty steed, Skaarl, who takes damage for him. When Skaarl's health depletes, Kled dismounts. While dismounted, Kled's abilities change and he deals less damage to champions. Kled can restore Skaarl's courage by fighting enemies. At maximum courage, Kled remounts with a portion of Skaarl's health.

spells.name: Bear Trap on a Rope
spells.desc: Kled throws a bear trap that damages and hooks an enemy champion. If shackled for a short duration, the target takes additional physical damage and is yanked toward Kled. When dismounted, this ability is replaced by Pocket Pistol, a ranged gun blast that knocks back Kled and restores courage.

spells.name: Violent Tendencies
spells.desc: Kled gains massive attack speed for four attacks. The fourth attack deals more damage.

spells.name: Jousting
spells.desc: Kled dashes, dealing physical damage and gaining a short burst of speed. Kled can cast this ability again to dash back through his initial target, dealing the same damage.

spells.name: Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
spells.desc: Kled and Skaarl charge to a location, leaving a speed-granting trail behind them and gaining a shield. Skaarl locks onto and rams the first enemy champion encountered.

blurb: A warrior as fearless as he is ornery, the yordle Kled embodies the furious bravado of Noxus. He is an icon beloved by the empire's soldiers, distrusted by its officers, and loathed by the nobility. Many claim Kled has fought in every campaign the...

name: Kog'Maw
title: the Mouth of the Abyss

passive.name: Icathian Surprise
passive.desc: 4 seconds after dying, Kogmaw explodes, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies.

spells.name: Caustic Spittle
spells.desc: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile which deals magic damage and corrodes the target's armor and magic resist for a short time. Kog'Maw also gains additional attack speed.

spells.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
spells.desc: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage On-Hit.

spells.name: Void Ooze
spells.desc: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.

spells.name: Living Artillery
spells.desc: Kog'Maw fires an artillery shell at a great distance dealing magic damage (increased significantly on low health enemies) and revealing non-stealthed targets. Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana.

blurb: Belched forth from a rotting Void incursion deep in the wastelands of Icathia, Kog'Maw is an inquisitive yet putrid creature with a caustic, gaping mouth. This particular Void-spawn needs to gnaw and drool on anything within reach to truly understand it...

name: LeBlanc
title: the Deceiver

passive.name: Mirror Image
passive.desc: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.

spells.name: Sigil of Malice
spells.desc: LeBlanc projects a sigil, dealing damage and marking the target for 3.5 seconds. Damaging the marked target with an ability detonates the sigil, dealing additional damage. If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds the Mana cost and part of this spell's remaining Cooldown.

spells.name: Distortion
spells.desc: LeBlanc dashes to a location, dealing damage to enemies near her destination. For the next 4 seconds, activate Distortion again to return LeBlanc to her starting location.

spells.name: Ethereal Chains
spells.desc: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.

spells.name: Mimic
spells.desc: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.

blurb: Mysterious even to other members of the Black Rose cabal, LeBlanc is but one of many names for a pale woman who has manipulated people and events since the earliest days of Noxus. Using her magic to mirror herself, the sorceress can appear to anyone...

name: Lee Sin
title: the Blind Monk

passive.name: Flurry
passive.desc: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.

spells.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
spells.desc: Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds. Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health.

spells.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
spells.desc: Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage. If the ally is a champion, they are also shielded. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will. Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle. Lee Sin gains Omnivamp.

spells.name: Tempest / Cripple
spells.desc: Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple. Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies damaged by Tempest, reducing their Move Speed. Move Speed recovers gradually over the duration.

spells.name: Dragon's Rage
spells.desc: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration. This technique was taught to him by Jesse Perring, although Lee Sin does not kick players off the map.

blurb: A master of Ionia's ancient martial arts, Lee Sin is a principled fighter who channels the essence of the dragon spirit to face any challenge. Though he lost his sight many years ago, the warrior-monk has devoted his life to protecting his homeland...

name: Lissandra
title: the Ice Witch

passive.name: Iceborn Subjugation
passive.desc: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a Frozen Thrall. Frozen Thralls slow nearby enemies and then, after a delay, shatter from the intense cold, dealing magic damage to nearby targets.

spells.name: Ice Shard
spells.desc: Throws a spear of ice that shatters when it hits an enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing Move Speed. Shards pass through the target, dealing the same damage to other enemies hit.

spells.name: Ring of Frost
spells.desc: Freezes nearby enemies in ice, dealing magic damage and rooting them.

spells.name: Glacial Path
spells.desc: Lissandra creates an ice claw that deals magic damage. Reactivating this ability transports Lissandra to the claw's current location.

spells.name: Frozen Tomb
spells.desc: If cast on an enemy champion, the target is frozen solid, stunning it. If cast on Lissandra, she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable. Dark ice then emanates from the target dealing magic damage to enemies and slowing Move Speed.

blurb: Lissandra's magic twists the pure power of ice into something dark and terrible. With the force of her black ice, she does more than freeze—she impales and crushes those who oppose her. To the terrified denizens of the north, she is known only as ''The...

name: Locke
title: the Ashen Exorcist

passive.name: Silver Stake
passive.desc: Locke's attacks deal additional magic damage On-Hit, increased based on enemy missing Health.

spells.name: Ritual Nails
spells.desc: Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing damage to and marking enemies hit. Locke can consume the marks to deal bonus damage with his attacks.

spells.name: Soul Ignition
spells.desc: Locke ignites his soul, gaining Attack Speed and Move Speed, and dealing damage to himself. At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect.
spells.costType: Mana and {{ healthcost*100 }}% Current Health Per Second

spells.name: Ashen Pursuit
spells.desc: Locke teleports to a location before dashing to attack his next target, dealing damage to enemies passed through.

spells.name: Purgatory
spells.desc: Locke throws a binding artifact that deals damage and potentially executes enemies hit. Locke gains additional power for sealing away enemy champions.

blurb: A nail-slinging exorcist versed in forbidden rites, Corvin Locke is the progeny of Demacian occultists. Born into lies and hypocrisy, he learned young that demons aren't the cause of humanity's darkness, but the consequence. Now, Locke tears through...

name: Lucian
title: the Purifier

passive.name: Lightslinger
passive.desc: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.

spells.name: Piercing Light
spells.desc: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.

spells.name: Ardent Blaze
spells.desc: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking and briefly revealing enemies. Lucian gains Move Speed for attacking marked enemies.

spells.name: Relentless Pursuit
spells.desc: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.

spells.name: The Culling
spells.desc: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.

blurb: Lucian, a Sentinel of Light, is a grim hunter of wraiths and specters, pursuing them relentlessly and annihilating them with his twin relic pistols. After the specter Thresh slew his wife, Lucian embarked on the path of vengeance—but even with her...

name: Lulu
title: the Fae Sorceress

passive.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
passive.desc: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.

spells.name: Glitterlance
spells.desc: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.

spells.name: Whimsy
spells.desc: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.

spells.name: Help, Pix!
spells.desc: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.

spells.name: Wild Growth
spells.desc: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.

blurb: The yordle mage Lulu is known for conjuring dreamlike illusions and fanciful creatures as she roams Runeterra with her fairy companion Pix. Lulu shapes reality on a whim, warping the fabric of the world, and what she views as the constraints of this...

name: Malzahar
title: the Prophet of the Void

passive.name: Void Shift
passive.desc: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.

spells.name: Call of the Void
spells.desc: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.

spells.name: Void Swarm
spells.desc: Malzahar summons Voidlings to attack nearby enemies.

spells.name: Malefic Visions
spells.desc: Malzahar infects his target's mind with cruel visions of their demise, dealing damage over time. Using Malzahar's other spells on the target will refresh the visions. If the target dies while afflicted by the visions, they pass on to a nearby enemy unit and Malzahar gains Mana. Malzahar's Voidlings are attracted to affected units.

spells.name: Nether Grasp
spells.desc: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion over a zone of damaging negative energy.

blurb: A zealous seer dedicated to the unification of all life, Malzahar truly believes the newly emergent Void to be the path to Runeterra's salvation. In the desert wastes of Shurima, he followed the voices that whispered in his mind, all the way to ancient...

name: Maokai
title: the Twisted Treant

passive.name: Sap Magic
passive.desc: Maokai's basic attack also heals him and deals additional damage on a moderate cooldown. Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.

spells.name: Bramble Smash
spells.desc: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.

spells.name: Twisted Advance
spells.desc: Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target. Upon arrival, he roots the target.

spells.name: Sapling Toss
spells.desc: Maokai flings a sapling to the target area to stand guard. More effective in brush.

spells.name: Nature's Grasp
spells.desc: Maokai summons a colossal wall of brambles and thorns that slowly advances forwards, damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.

blurb: Maokai is a rageful, towering treant who fights the unnatural horrors of the Shadow Isles. He was twisted into a force of vengeance after a magical cataclysm destroyed his home, surviving undeath only through the Waters of Life infused within his...

name: Mel
title: the Soul's Reflection

passive.name: Searing Brilliance
passive.desc: Whenever Mel uses an ability, she gains three bonus projectiles (up to nine maximum) on her next attack. When Mel deals damage through an ability or attack, she applies Overwhelm, which can stack infinitely. If the enemy is hit by Mel with enough Overwhelm damage, the stacks are consumed to execute the target.

spells.name: Radiant Barrage
spells.desc: Mel unleashes a volley of projectiles that deal magic damage. Hitting an enemy champion reduces this ability's cooldown.

spells.name: Rebuttal
spells.desc: Mel unleashes a refraction nova that destroys enemy projectiles it collides with, retaliating with magic missiles. The nova also shields and grants move speed to Mel and her allies.

spells.name: Solar Snare
spells.desc: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, rooting those at its center while the area around it slows enemies and deals damage over time.

spells.name: Golden Eclipse
spells.desc: Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm. Ranks of Golden Eclipse increase Overwhelm's damage.

blurb: Mel Medarda is the presumed heir of the Medarda family, once one of the most powerful in Noxus. In appearance she is a graceful aristocrat, but beneath the surface lies a skilled politician who makes it her business to know everything about everyone she...

name: Milio
title: The Gentle Flame

passive.name: Fired Up!
passive.desc: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.

spells.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
spells.desc: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.

spells.name: Cozy Campfire
spells.desc: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.

spells.name: Warm Hugs
spells.desc: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed. This ability has 2 charges.

spells.name: Breath of Life
spells.desc: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.

blurb: Milio is a warmhearted boy from Ixtal who has, despite his young age, mastered the fire axiom and discovered something new: soothing fire. With this newfound power, Milio plans to help his family escape their exile by joining the Yun Tal—just like his...

name: Miss Fortune
title: the Bounty Hunter

passive.name: Love Tap
passive.desc: Miss Fortune deals bonus physical damage whenever she basic attacks a new target.

spells.name: Double Up
spells.desc: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them. Both strikes can also apply Love Tap.

spells.name: Strut
spells.desc: Miss Fortune passively gains Move Speed when not attacked. This ability can be activated to grant bonus Attack Speed for a short duration. While it's on cooldown, Love Taps reduce the remaining cooldown of Strut.

spells.name: Make It Rain
spells.desc: Miss Fortune reveals an area with a flurry of bullets, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.

spells.name: Bullet Time
spells.desc: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies. Each wave of Bullet Time can critically strike

blurb: A Bilgewater captain famed for her looks but feared for her ruthlessness, Sarah Fortune paints a stark figure among the hardened criminals of the port city. As a child, she witnessed the reaver king Gangplank murder her family—an act she brutally...

name: Mordekaiser
title: the Iron Revenant

passive.name: Darkness Rise
passive.desc: Mordekaiser gains a powerful damage aura and Move Speed after landing 3 attacks or spells against champions or monsters.

spells.name: Obliterate
spells.desc: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.

spells.name: Indestructible
spells.desc: Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.

spells.name: Death's Grasp
spells.desc: Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in an area.

spells.name: Realm of Death
spells.desc: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.

blurb: Twice slain and thrice born, Mordekaiser is a brutal warlord from a foregone epoch who uses his necromantic sorcery to bind souls into an eternity of servitude. Few now remain who remember his earlier conquests, or know the true extent of his powers—but...

name: Nami
title: the Tidecaller

passive.name: Surging Tides
passive.desc: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

spells.name: Aqua Prison
spells.desc: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.

spells.name: Ebb and Flow
spells.desc: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allied and enemy champions, healing allies and damaging enemies.

spells.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
spells.desc: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.

spells.name: Tidal Wave
spells.desc: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies. Allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides.

blurb: A headstrong young vastaya of the seas, Nami was the first of the Marai tribe to leave the waves and venture onto dry land, when their ancient accord with the Targonians was broken. With no other option, she took it upon herself to complete the sacred...

name: Nasus
title: the Curator of the Sands

passive.name: Soul Eater
passive.desc: Nasus drains his foe's spiritual energy, giving him bonus Life Steal.

spells.name: Siphoning Strike
spells.desc: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.

spells.name: Wither
spells.desc: Nasus ages an enemy champion, decelerating their Move Speed and Attack Speed over time.

spells.name: Spirit Fire
spells.desc: Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a location, dealing damage and reducing the Armor of enemies who stand on it.

spells.name: Fury of the Sands
spells.desc: Nasus unleashes a mighty sandstorm that batters nearby enemies. While the storm rages, he gains increased Health, Attack Range, damages nearby enemies, has a reduced cooldown on Siphoning Strike, and gains bonus Armor and Magic Resistance.

blurb: Nasus is an imposing, jackal-headed Ascended being from ancient Shurima, a heroic figure regarded as a demigod by the people of the desert. Fiercely intelligent, he was a guardian of knowledge and peerless strategist whose wisdom guided the ancient...

name: Nautilus
title: the Titan of the Depths

passive.name: Staggering Blow
passive.desc: Nautilus' first Attack against a target deals increased physical damage and roots them briefly.

spells.name: Dredge Line
spells.desc: Nautilus hurls his anchor forward. Colliding with an enemy pulls them and Nautilus together, dealing magic damage. Colliding with terrain pulls Nautilus towards it.

spells.name: Titan's Wrath
spells.desc: Nautilus gains a temporary Shield. While it persists, his Attacks deal damage over time to his target and surrounding enemies.

spells.name: Riptide
spells.desc: Nautilus creates three exploding waves around himself. Each explosion damages and slows enemies.

spells.name: Depth Charge
spells.desc: Nautilus fires a shockwave into the earth that chases an opponent. This shockwave rips up the earth above it, knocking enemies into the air. When it reaches the opponent, the shockwave erupts, knocking his target into the air and stunning them.

blurb: A lonely legend as old as the first piers sunk in Bilgewater, the armored goliath known as Nautilus roams the dark waters off the coast of the Blue Flame Isles. Driven by a forgotten betrayal, he strikes without warning, swinging his enormous anchor to...

name: Neeko
title: the Curious Chameleon

passive.name: Inherent Glamour
passive.desc: Neeko can look like an ally champion or as other units on the map. Receiving immobilizing crowd control, casting damaging spells, damaging enemy towers as a non-champion, or your disguise taking damage equal to its healthbar breaks the disguise.

spells.name: Blooming Burst
spells.desc: Neeko throws a seed dealing magic damage. The seed blooms again on hitting champions or killing units.

spells.name: Shapesplitter
spells.desc: Neeko passively deals bonus magic damage every third attack, briefly increasing her move speed. Neeko can activate to send a clone in a direction and recast to change the direction of the clone.

spells.name: Tangle-Barbs
spells.desc: Neeko slings a tangle that damages and roots everything it passes through. If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer.

spells.name: Pop Blossom
spells.desc: After a short preparation, Neeko leaps into the air, knocking up all nearby enemies. Upon landing, nearby enemies are damaged and stunned. The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.

blurb: Hailing from a long lost tribe of vastaya, Neeko can blend into any crowd by borrowing the appearances of others, even absorbing something of their emotional state to tell friend from foe in an instant. No one is ever sure where—or who—Neeko might be...

name: Nidalee
title: the Bestial Huntress

passive.name: Prowl
passive.desc: Moving through brush increases Nidalee's Move Speed by 10% for 2 seconds, increased to 30% toward visible enemy champions within 1400 range. Hitting champions or monsters with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack triggers a Hunt, granting True Sight of them for 4 seconds. During this time, Nidalee gains 10% Move Speed (increased to 30% toward the Hunted target) and her Takedown and Pounce are enhanced against them.

spells.name: Javelin Toss / Takedown
spells.desc: In human form, Nidalee throws a spiked javelin at her target that gains damage as it flies. As a cougar, her next attack will attempt to fatally wound her target, dealing more damage the less life they have.

spells.name: Bushwhack / Pounce
spells.desc: In human form, Nidalee lays a trap for unwary opponents that, when sprung, damages and reveals its target. As a cougar, she jumps in a direction, dealing damage in an area where she lands.

spells.name: Primal Surge / Swipe
spells.desc: In human form, Nidalee channels the spirit of the cougar to heal her allies and imbue them with Attack Speed for a short duration. As a cougar, she claws in a direction, dealing damage to enemies in front of her.

spells.name: Aspect Of The Cougar
spells.desc: Nidalee transforms into a cougar, gaining new abilities.

blurb: Raised in the deepest jungle, Nidalee is a master tracker who can shapeshift into a ferocious cougar at will. Neither wholly woman nor beast, she viciously defends her territory from any and all trespassers, with carefully placed traps and deft spear...

name: Nilah
title: the Joy Unbound

passive.name: Joy Unending
passive.desc: Nilah gains increased experience from last-hitting minions along with the ability to enhance and share nearby healing and shielding from her allies.

spells.name: Formless Blade
spells.desc: With a snap of her whip-blade, Nilah damages any enemies she hits in a straight line in her chosen direction. This action extends her attack range for a short duration.

spells.name: Jubilant Veil
spells.desc: Nilah envelops herself in mist, increasing her movement speed and allowing her to gracefully dodge all incoming attacks. Any allies she touches during the mist's duration will also gain this effect.

spells.name: Slipstream
spells.desc: Nilah enthusiastically dashes toward her target, dealing damage to any enemies she passes through on the way.

spells.name: Apotheosis
spells.desc: Twirling her whip-blade in joyful exuberance, Nilah deals damage to enemies around her before pulling them closer with her weapon.

blurb: Nilah is an ascetic warrior from a distant land, seeking the world's deadliest, most titanic opponents so that she might challenge and destroy them. Having won her power through an encounter with the long-imprisoned demon of joy, she has no emotions...

name: Nocturne
title: the Eternal Nightmare

passive.name: Umbra Blades
passive.desc: Every few seconds, Nocturne's next attack strikes surrounding enemies for bonus physical damage and heals himself. Nocturne's basic attacks reduce this cooldown.

spells.name: Duskbringer
spells.desc: Nocturne throws a shadow blade that deals damage, leaves a Dusk Trail, and causes champions to leave a Dusk Trail. While on the trail, Nocturne can move through units and has increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.

spells.name: Shroud of Darkness
spells.desc: Nocturne empowers his blades, passively gaining Attack Speed. Activating Shroud of Darkness allows Nocturne to fade into the shadows, creating a magical barrier which blocks a single enemy ability and doubles his passive Attack Speed if successful.

spells.name: Unspeakable Horror
spells.desc: Nocturne plants a nightmare into his target's mind, dealing damage each second and applying fear to the target if they do not get out of range by the end of the duration.

spells.name: Paranoia
spells.desc: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.

blurb: A demonic amalgamation drawn from the nightmares that haunt every sentient mind, the thing known as Nocturne has become a primordial force of pure evil. It is liquidly chaotic in aspect, a faceless shadow with cold eyes and armed with wicked-looking...

name: Nunu & Willump
title: the Boy and His Yeti

passive.name: Call of the Freljord
passive.desc: Nunu increases the attack speed and Move Speed of Willump and a nearby ally, and causes Willump's basic attacks to damage enemies around the target.

spells.name: Consume
spells.desc: Willump takes a bite out of a minion, monster, or enemy champion, dealing damage and healing himself.

spells.name: Biggest Snowball Ever!
spells.desc: Willump creates a snowball that grows in size and speed as he rolls it. The snowball damages and knocks up enemies.

spells.name: Snowball Barrage
spells.desc: Nunu throws multiple snowballs that damage enemies. When he's finished, Willump roots any champions or large monsters that were hit by a snowball.

spells.name: Absolute Zero
spells.desc: Nunu & Willump create a powerful blizzard in an area that slows enemies and deals massive damage at the end.

blurb: Once upon a time, there was a boy who wanted to prove he was a hero by slaying a fearsome monster—only to discover that the beast, a lonely and magical yeti, merely needed a friend. Bound together by ancient power and a shared love of snowballs, Nunu...

name: Olaf
title: the Berserker

passive.name: Berserker Rage
passive.desc: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.

spells.name: Undertow
spells.desc: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.

spells.name: Tough It Out
spells.desc: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.

spells.name: Reckless Swing
spells.desc: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.

spells.name: Ragnarok
spells.desc: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.

blurb: An unstoppable force of destruction, the axe-wielding Olaf wants nothing but to die in glorious combat. Hailing from the brutal Freljordian peninsula of Lokfar, he once received a prophecy foretelling his peaceful passing—a coward's fate, and a great...

name: Orianna
title: the Lady of Clockwork

passive.name: Clockwork Windup
passive.desc: Orianna's Attacks deal additional magic damage. This damage increases the more Orianna Attacks the same target.

spells.name: Command: Attack
spells.desc: Orianna commands her Ball to fire toward a target location, dealing magic damage to targets along the way (deals less damage to subsequent targets). Her Ball remains at the target location after.

spells.name: Command: Dissonance
spells.desc: Orianna commands her Ball to release a pulse of energy, dealing magic damage around it. This leaves a field behind that speeds up allies and slows enemies.

spells.name: Command: Protect
spells.desc: Orianna commands her Ball to attach to an allied champion, Shielding them and dealing magic damage to any enemies it passes through on the way. Additionally, the Ball grants additional Armor and Magic Resist to the champion it is attached to.

spells.name: Command: Shockwave
spells.desc: Orianna commands her Ball to unleash a shockwave, dealing magic damage and launching nearby enemies towards the Ball after a short delay.

blurb: Once a curious girl of flesh and blood, Orianna is now a technological marvel comprised entirely of clockwork. She became gravely ill after an accident in the lower districts of Zaun, and her failing body had to be replaced with exquisite artifice...

name: Ornn
title: The Fire below the Mountain

passive.name: Living Forge
passive.desc: Ornn gains an additional bonus Armor and Magic Resist from all sources. Ornn can spend gold to forge non-consumable items anywhere. Additionally, he can create masterwork items for himself and for his allies.

spells.name: Volcanic Rupture
spells.desc: Ornn slams the ground, sending out a fissure dealing damage and slowing enemies hit. After a small delay, a magma pillar forms at the end location.

spells.name: Bellows Breath
spells.desc: Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle.

spells.name: Searing Charge
spells.desc: Ornn charges, dealing damage to enemies he passes through. If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave around him which deals damage and knocks up enemies.

spells.name: Call of the Forge God
spells.desc: Ornn summons a massive elemental at a location which travels toward him with increasing speed. Enemies run over by the elemental take damage, are slowed and are made Brittle. Ornn can recast the ability to charge into the elemental, redirecting it in the direction he hits it, causing the elemental to affect any enemies it runs over to be knocked up, dealing the same damage and re-applying Brittle.

blurb: Ornn is the Freljordian spirit of forging and craftsmanship. He works in the solitude of a massive smithy, hammered out from the lava caverns beneath the volcano Hearth-Home. There he stokes bubbling cauldrons of molten rock to purify ores and fashion...

name: Pantheon
title: the Unbreakable Spear

passive.name: Mortal Will
passive.desc: Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.

spells.name: Comet Spear
spells.desc: Pantheon either thrusts his spear or throws his spear in the chosen direction.

spells.name: Shield Vault
spells.desc: Pantheon dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them.

spells.name: Aegis Assault
spells.desc: Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear.

spells.name: Grand Starfall
spells.desc: Pantheon composes himself and then leaps into the air, landing at a chosen location as a comet.

blurb: Once an unwilling host to the Aspect of War, Atreus survived when the celestial power within him was slain, refusing to succumb to a blow that tore stars from the heavens. In time, he learned to embrace the power of his own mortality, and the stubborn...

name: Poppy
title: Keeper of the Hammer

passive.name: Iron Ambassador
passive.desc: Poppy throws her buckler that bounces off the target. Poppy can pick it up to gain a temporary shield.

spells.name: Hammer Shock
spells.desc: Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.

spells.name: Steadfast Presence
spells.desc: Poppy passively gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus increases when she is low on Health. Poppy can activate Steadfast Presence to gain Move Speed and stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.

spells.name: Heroic Charge
spells.desc: Poppy dashes to the target and pushes it back. If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned.

spells.name: Keeper's Verdict
spells.desc: Poppy channels a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away.

blurb: Runeterra has no shortage of valiant champions, but few are as tenacious as Poppy. Bearing the legendary hammer of Orlon, a weapon twice her size, this determined yordle has spent untold years searching in secret for the fabled “Hero of Demacia,” said...

name: Pyke
title: the Bloodharbor Ripper

passive.name: Gift of the Drowned Ones
passive.desc: When Pyke is hidden from enemies, he regenerates damage that he has recently taken from champions. Pyke also cannot gain extra Maximum Health from any source, and instead gains Bonus AD.

spells.name: Bone Skewer
spells.desc: Pyke either stabs an enemy in front of him or pulls an enemy towards him.

spells.name: Ghostwater Dive
spells.desc: Pyke enters Camouflage and gains significant Move Speed that decays over time.

spells.name: Phantom Undertow
spells.desc: Pyke dashes and leaves behind a phantom that will return to him, stunning enemy champions along its path.

spells.name: Death From Below
spells.desc: Pyke blinks to and executes low health enemies, allowing him to cast this spell again and granting additional gold to an ally who assists.

blurb: A renowned harpooner from the slaughter docks of Bilgewater, Pyke should have met his death in the belly of a gigantic jaull-fish… and yet, he returned. Now, stalking the dank alleys and backways of his former hometown, he uses his new supernatural...

name: Qiyana
title: Empress of the Elements

passive.name: Royal Privilege
passive.desc: Qiyana's first basic attack or ability against each enemy deals bonus damage.

spells.name: Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal
spells.desc: Qiyana swings her weapon, dealing damage with a bonus effect based on her element.

spells.name: Terrashape
spells.desc: Qiyana dashes to a location and enchants her weapon with an element. Her attacks and abilities deal bonus damage while her weapon is enchanted.

spells.name: Audacity
spells.desc: Qiyana dashes to an enemy, damaging them.

spells.name: Supreme Display of Talent
spells.desc: Qiyana sends out a shockwave that detonates whatever elements she hits with it, stunning and damaging nearby enemies.

blurb: In the jungle city of Ixaocan, Qiyana plots her own ruthless path to the high seat of the Yun Tal. Last in line to succeed her parents, she faces those who stand in her way with brash confidence and unprecedented mastery over elemental magic. With the...

name: Quinn
title: Demacia's Wings

passive.name: Harrier
passive.desc: Valor, Quinn's Demacian eagle, periodically marks enemies with Harrier. Quinn's first basic attack against Harrier targets will deal bonus physical damage.

spells.name: Blinding Assault
spells.desc: Quinn calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision before damaging all enemies in the immediate area.

spells.name: Heightened Senses
spells.desc: Passively grants Quinn Attack Speed and Move Speed after she attacks a Harrier target. Activate to have Valor reveal a large area nearby.

spells.name: Vault
spells.desc: Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target.

spells.name: Behind Enemy Lines
spells.desc: Quinn and Valor team up to fly around at great speed. Ending the ability casts Skystrike, which deals damage to nearby enemies and marks champions with Harrier.

blurb: Quinn is an elite ranger-knight of Demacia, who undertakes dangerous missions deep in enemy territory. She and her legendary eagle, Valor, share an unbreakable bond, and their foes are often slain before they realize they are fighting not one, but two...

name: Rakan
title: The Charmer

passive.name: Fey Feathers
passive.desc: Rakan periodically gains a shield.

spells.name: Gleaming Quill
spells.desc: Flings a magical feather that deals magic damage. Striking a champion or epic monster enables Rakan to heal his allies.

spells.name: Grand Entrance
spells.desc: Dashes to a location, knocking up nearby enemies on arrival.

spells.name: Battle Dance
spells.desc: Flies to an allied champion granting them a shield. Can be re-cast for free for a short duration.

spells.name: The Quickness
spells.desc: Gains Move Speed, charming and dealing magic damage to enemies touched.

blurb: As mercurial as he is charming, Rakan is an infamous vastayan troublemaker and the greatest battle-dancer in Lhotlan tribal history. To the humans of the Ionian highlands, his name has long been synonymous with wild festivals, uncontrollable parties...

name: Rammus
title: the Armordillo

passive.name: Spiked Shell
passive.desc: Rammus gains bonus Attack Damage scaling with his Armor and Magic Resistance.

spells.name: Powerball
spells.desc: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.

spells.name: Defensive Ball Curl
spells.desc: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his Armor and Magic Resistance, and returning damage to enemies that attack him.

spells.name: Frenzying Taunt
spells.desc: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against him.

spells.name: Soaring Slam
spells.desc: Rammus hops into the air and slams down at a target area, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If cast while Rammus is in Powerball, Rammus knocks up enemies near the center as well.

blurb: Idolized by many, dismissed by some, mystifying to all, the curious being Rammus is an enigma. Protected by a spiked shell, he inspires increasingly disparate theories on his origin wherever he goes—from demigod, to sacred oracle, to a mere beast...

name: Rek'Sai
title: the Void Burrower

passive.name: Fury of the Xer'Sai
passive.desc: Rek'Sai generates Fury by Attacking and hitting with basic Abilities. She consumes this Fury while Burrowed to restore health.

spells.name: Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker
spells.desc: Rek'Sai's next 3 basic attacks deal bonus Physical Damage to nearby enemies. While Burrowed, Rek'Sai launches a burst of void-charged earth that damages and reveals enemies hit.

spells.name: Burrow / Un-burrow
spells.desc: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining new abilities and increased Move Speed. Her vision range is reduced and she cannot use basic attacks. While Burrowed, Rek'Sai may cast Unburrow to knock up and damage nearby enemies.

spells.name: Furious Bite / Tunnel
spells.desc: Rek'Sai bites her target, dealing physical damage, or bonus true damage if she has max Fury. While Burrowed, Rek'Sai creates a re-usable, long lasting tunnel. Enemies can destroy it by standing on top of either entrance.

spells.name: Void Rush
spells.desc: Rek'Sai passively marks targets by damaging them. She can activate this ability to become briefly untargetable and lunge at a marked target for heavy damage based on their maximum health.

blurb: An apex predator, Rek'Sai is a merciless Void-spawn that tunnels beneath the ground to ambush and devour unsuspecting prey. Her insatiable hunger has laid waste to entire regions of the once-great empire of Shurima—merchants, traders, even armed...

name: Rell
title: the Iron Maiden

passive.name: Break the Mold
passive.desc: Rell's Attacks and Abilities deal additional magic damage and steal Armor and Magic Resist on hit.

spells.name: Shattering Strike
spells.desc: Rell deals magic damage to units in a line, breaking their shields and stunning them.

spells.name: Ferromancy: Crash Down
spells.desc: Mounted: Rell Dismounts, crashing down in her armor, Knocking enemies up and gaining a large Shield. While dismounted, she gains Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Speed, and Attack Range, but is Slowed. Dismounted: Rell forms her Mount, gaining a burst of speed and Knocking Up the next enemy she attacks.

spells.name: Full Tilt
spells.desc: Passive: Rell gains out of combat Move Speed. Active: Rell and an ally gain ramping Move Speed, doubled toward enemies and each other. Her next Attack explodes, dealing magic damage.

spells.name: Magnet Storm
spells.desc: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently Pulling nearby enemies toward herself. Then Rell constantly Drags nearby enemies toward herself for a short while, dealing magic damage over time.

blurb: The product of brutal experimentation at the hands of the Black Rose, Rell is a defiant, living weapon determined to topple Noxus. Her childhood was one of misery and horror, enduring unspeakable procedures to perfect and weaponize her magical control...

name: Renata Glasc
title: the Chem-Baroness

passive.name: Leverage
passive.desc: Renata's Attacks deal bonus damage and mark enemies. Renata's allies can damage marked enemies to deal bonus damage.

spells.name: Handshake
spells.desc: Renata sends out a missile rooting the first enemy hit, and can recast the ability to throw the unit in a direction.

spells.name: Bailout
spells.desc: Renata buffs an allied champion to fight harder, delaying their death and potentially saving them if they get a takedown.

spells.name: Loyalty Program
spells.desc: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, shielding allies and damaging and slowing enemies hit.

spells.name: Hostile Takeover
spells.desc: Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, causing any enemies hit to go Berserk.

blurb: Renata Glasc rose from the ashes of her childhood home with nothing but her name and her parents' alchemical research. In the decades since, she has become Zaun's wealthiest chem-baron, a business magnate who built her power by tying everyone's...

name: Renekton
title: the Butcher of the Sands

passive.name: Reign of Anger
passive.desc: Renekton's attacks generate Fury, increased when he is low on life. This Fury can empower his abilities with bonus effects.

spells.name: Cull the Meek
spells.desc: Renekton swings his blade, dealing moderate physical damage to all targets around him, and heals for a small portion of the damage dealt. If he has more than 50 Fury, his damage and heal are increased.

spells.name: Ruthless Predator
spells.desc: Renekton slashes his target twice, dealing moderate physical damage and stuns them for 0.75 seconds. If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target, dealing high physical damage, and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

spells.name: Slice and Dice
spells.desc: Renekton dashes, dealing damage to units along the way. Empowered, Renekton deals bonus damage and reduces the Armor of units hit.

spells.name: Dominus
spells.desc: Renekton transforms into the Tyrant form, gaining bonus Health and dealing damage to enemies around him. While in this form, Renekton gains Fury periodically.

blurb: Renekton is a terrifying, rage-fueled Ascended being from the scorched deserts of Shurima. Once, he was his empire's most esteemed warrior, leading the nation's armies to countless victories. However, after the empire's fall, Renekton was entombed...

name: Riven
title: the Exile

passive.name: Runic Blade
passive.desc: Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.

spells.name: Broken Wings
spells.desc: Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.

spells.name: Ki Burst
spells.desc: Riven emits a Ki Burst, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.

spells.name: Valor
spells.desc: Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.

spells.name: Blade of the Exile
spells.desc: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.

blurb: Once a swordmaster in the warhosts of Noxus, Riven is an expatriate in a land she previously tried to conquer. She rose through the ranks on the strength of her conviction and brutal efficiency, and was rewarded with a legendary runic blade and a...

name: Rumble
title: the Mechanized Menace

passive.name: Junkyard Titan
passive.desc: Every spell Rumble casts gives him Heat. When he reaches 50% Heat he reaches Danger Zone, granting all his basic abilities bonus effects. When he reaches 100% Heat, he starts Overheating, gaining bonus Attack Speed and granting his basic attacks bonus damage, but making him unable to cast spells for a few seconds.

spells.name: Flamespitter
spells.desc: Rumble torches opponents in front of him, dealing magic damage in a cone for 3 seconds. While in Danger Zone this damage is increased.

spells.name: Scrap Shield
spells.desc: Rumble pulls up a shield, protecting him from damage and granting him a quick burst of speed. While in Danger Zone, the shield strength and speed bonus is increased.

spells.name: Electro Harpoon
spells.desc: Rumble launches a harpoon, electrocuting his target with magic damage, slowing their Move Speed, and reducing their Magic Resist. Rumble can carry 2 harpoons at a time. While in Danger Zone the damage and slow percentage is increased.

spells.name: The Equalizer
spells.desc: Rumble fires off a group of rockets, creating a wall of flames that damages and slows enemies.

blurb: Rumble is a young inventor with a temper. Using nothing more than his own two hands and a heap of scrap, the feisty yordle constructed a colossal mech suit outfitted with an arsenal of electrified harpoons and incendiary rockets. Though others may scoff...

name: Ryze
title: the Rune Mage

passive.name: Arcane Mastery
passive.desc: Ryze's spells deal extra damage based on his Bonus Mana, and he gains a percentage increase to his maximum Mana based on his Ability Power.

spells.name: Overload
spells.desc: Passively, Ryze's other basic abilities reset the cooldown of Overload and charge a rune. When Ryze casts Overload with 2 runes charged, he gains a brief burst of Move Speed. On cast, Ryze throws a charge of pure energy in a line, dealing damage to the first enemy struck. If the target has Flux on it, Overload deals extra damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux.

spells.name: Rune Prison
spells.desc: Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.

spells.name: Spell Flux
spells.desc: Ryze releases an orb of pure magical power that damages an enemy and debuffs all nearby enemies. Ryze's spells have additional effects against the debuffed enemy.

spells.name: Realm Warp
spells.desc: Passively, Overload deals even more damage against targets with Flux. On cast, Ryze creates a portal to a nearby location. After a few seconds, allies standing near the portal are teleported to the target location.

blurb: Widely considered one of the most adept sorcerers on Runeterra, Ryze is an ancient, hard-bitten archmage with an impossibly heavy burden to bear. Armed with immense arcane power and a boundless constitution, he tirelessly hunts for World Runes—fragments...

name: Samira
title: the Desert Rose

passive.name: Daredevil Impulse
passive.desc: Samira builds a combo by hitting attacks or abilities unique from the previous hit. Samira's attacks in melee range deal additional magic damage. Samira's attacks against enemies affected by Immobilizing effects will dash her to her attack range. If the enemy is Knocked Up, she also keeps them Knocked Up briefly.

spells.name: Flair
spells.desc: Samira fires a shot or swings her sword, dealing damage. If cast during Wild Rush, strike all enemies in her path upon completion.

spells.name: Blade Whirl
spells.desc: Samira slashes around her, damaging enemies and destroying enemy missiles.

spells.name: Wild Rush
spells.desc: Samira dashes through an enemy (including structures), slashing enemies she passes through and gaining Attack Speed. Killing an enemy champion refreshes this ability's cooldown.

spells.name: Inferno Trigger
spells.desc: Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her.

blurb: Samira stares death in the eye with unyielding confidence, seeking thrill wherever she goes. After her Shuriman home was destroyed as a child, Samira found her true calling in Noxus, where she built a reputation as a stylish daredevil taking on...

name: Sejuani
title: Fury of the North

passive.name: Fury of the North
passive.desc: After being out of combat, Sejuani gains Frost Armor which grants Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows. Frost Armor persists for a short time after Sejuani takes damage. Sejuani can damage a stunned enemy to shatter it, dealing massive magic damage.

spells.name: Arctic Assault
spells.desc: Sejuani charges forward, knocking enemies into the air. The charge stops after hitting an enemy champion.

spells.name: Winter's Wrath
spells.desc: Sejuani swings her mace twice, dealing damage, slowing enemies and applying Frost stacks.

spells.name: Permafrost
spells.desc: Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks.

spells.name: Glacial Prison
spells.desc: Sejuani throws her bola that freezes and stuns the first champion hit and creates an ice storm that slows other enemies.

blurb: Sejuani is the brutal, unforgiving Iceborn warmother of the Winter's Claw, one of the most feared tribes of the Freljord. Her people's survival is a constant, desperate battle against the elements, forcing them to raid Noxians, Demacians, and Avarosans...

name: Senna
title: the Redeemer

passive.name: Absolution
passive.desc: When units die near Senna, their souls are periodically trapped by the Black Mist. Senna can attack these souls to free them, absorbing the Mist that held them in death. Mist fuels her Relic Cannon's power with increased Attack Damage, Attack Range, and Critical Strike Chance. Attacks from Senna's Relic Cannon take longer to fire, deal bonus damage, and briefly grant her a portion of her target's Move Speed.

spells.name: Piercing Darkness
spells.desc: From the twin barrels of her Relic Cannon, Senna fires a unified beam of light and shadow through a target, healing allies and damaging enemies.

spells.name: Last Embrace
spells.desc: Senna sends forth a wave of Black Mist. If it hits an enemy it latches onto them hungrily, rooting them and everything nearby after a brief delay.

spells.name: Curse of the Black Mist
spells.desc: Senna draws the Mist she has stored in her weapon into a storm around her, embracing darkness and becoming a wraith within. Allies who enter the area are camouflaged and also appear as wraiths as the Mist shrouds them. Wraiths gain increased Move Speed, are unselectable, and hide their identities.

spells.name: Dawning Shadow
spells.desc: Senna calls upon the relic stones of fallen Sentinels, splitting her relic cannon into a holy array of shadow and light. She then fires a global beam that shields allies from harm, while damaging enemies caught in the center.

blurb: Cursed from childhood to be haunted by the supernatural Black Mist, Senna joined a sacred order known as the Sentinels of Light, and fiercely fought back—only to be killed, her soul imprisoned in a lantern by the cruel specter Thresh. But refusing to...

name: Seraphine
title: the Starry-Eyed Songstress

passive.name: Stage Presence
passive.desc: Every third basic spell will cast twice from Seraphine. Additionally, casting spells near allies grants her bonus magic damage and range on her next basic attack.

spells.name: High Note
spells.desc: Seraphine deals damage in an area.

spells.name: Surround Sound
spells.desc: Seraphine Shields and Hastes nearby allies. If she is already Shielded she will Heal nearby allies as well.

spells.name: Beat Drop
spells.desc: Seraphine deals damage and impairs the movement of enemies in a line.

spells.name: Encore
spells.desc: Seraphine deals damage and charms enemies hit, refreshing the range with every allied or enemy champion hit.

blurb: Born in Piltover to Zaunite parents, Seraphine can hear the souls of others—the world sings to her, and she sings back. Though these sounds overwhelmed her in her youth, she now draws on them for inspiration, turning the chaos into a symphony. She...

name: Sett
title: the Boss

passive.name: Pit Grit
passive.desc: Sett's basic attacks alternate between left and right punch. Right punch is slightly stronger and faster. Sett also hates losing, gaining additional health regeneration based off of his missing health.

spells.name: Knuckle Down
spells.desc: Sett's next two attacks deal additional damage based off of the target's max health. Sett also gains Move Speed while moving towards enemy champions.

spells.name: Haymaker
spells.desc: Sett passively stores damage he takes as Grit. On cast, Sett expends all stored Grit to gain a shield and punch an area, dealing true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides.

spells.name: Facebreaker
spells.desc: Sett pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him, dealing damage and stunning them. If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.

spells.name: The Show Stopper
spells.desc: Sett carries an enemy champion through the air and slams them into the ground, dealing damage and slowing all enemies near where they land.

blurb: A leader of Ionia's growing criminal underworld, Sett rose to prominence in the wake of the war with Noxus. Though he began as a humble challenger in the fighting pits of Navori, he quickly gained notoriety for his savage strength, and his ability to...

name: Shaco
title: the Demon Jester

passive.name: Backstab
passive.desc: Shaco's basic attacks and Two-Shiv Poison deal additional damage when striking from behind.

spells.name: Deceive
spells.desc: Shaco becomes Invisible and teleports to target location. His first attack while Invisible is empowered, dealing bonus damage and critically striking if he attacks from behind.

spells.name: Jack In The Box
spells.desc: Shaco creates a hidden animated Jack-in-the-Box. When triggered, it will fear and attack nearby enemies.

spells.name: Two-Shiv Poison
spells.desc: Shaco's Shivs passively poison targets on hit, slowing their Move Speed. He can throw his Shivs to deal damage and poison the target. The thrown Shiv deals bonus damage if the target is below 30% health.

spells.name: Hallucinate
spells.desc: Shaco creates an illusion of himself near him, which can attack nearby enemies (Deals reduced damage to turrets). Upon death, it explodes, spawning three mini Jack in the Boxes and dealing damage to nearby enemies.

blurb: Crafted long ago as a plaything for a lonely prince, the enchanted marionette Shaco now delights in murder and mayhem. Corrupted by dark magic and the loss of his beloved charge, the once-kind puppet finds pleasure only in the misery of the poor souls...

name: Shen
title: the Eye of Twilight

passive.name: Ki Barrier
passive.desc: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.

spells.name: Twilight Assault
spells.desc: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.

spells.name: Spirit's Refuge
spells.desc: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.

spells.name: Shadow Dash
spells.desc: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.

spells.name: Stand United
spells.desc: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.

blurb: Among the secretive, Ionian warriors known as the Kinkou, Shen serves as their leader, the Eye of Twilight. He longs to remain free from the confusion of emotion, prejudice, and ego, and walks the unseen path of dispassionate judgment between the spirit...

name: Shyvana
title: the Half-Dragon

passive.name: Scalemail
passive.desc: Takedowns on enemy champions, large minions, and large monsters grant Shyvana Scalemail stacks, improving her defenses.

spells.name: Emberstrike
spells.desc: Shyvana's next attack strikes both the target and the surrounding area. This Ability can be recast. While in Dragon Form, it gains an additional recast, dealing massive damage to a single target.

spells.name: Inferno Aegis
spells.desc: Shyvana gains a shield, movement speed, and after a short delay, the area around her detonates. While in Dragon Form, the explosion will heal her if it strikes an enemy champion.

spells.name: Molten Burst
spells.desc: Shyvana launches a fireball that explodes upon striking a large target and slows them. In Dragon Form, it passes through and explodes upon striking large enemies, leaving behind a trail of fire.

spells.name: Dragon's Descent
spells.desc: Shyvana transforms into a Dragon and leaps forward causing enemies along her path to flee. While in Dragon form she becomes larger and her basic abilities are empowered.

blurb: Shyvana is a fearsome half-dragon warrior. Though she often appears humanoid, she also rules the skies as a dragon, incinerating her foes with fiery breath. Having saved the life of the crown prince Jarvan IV, Shyvana now serves uneasily in his royal...

name: Singed
title: the Mad Chemist

passive.name: Noxious Slipstream
passive.desc: Singed drafts off nearby champions, gaining a burst of Move Speed when passing them.

spells.name: Poison Trail
spells.desc: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.

spells.name: Mega Adhesive
spells.desc: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.

spells.name: Fling
spells.desc: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.

spells.name: Insanity Potion
spells.desc: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.

blurb: Singed is a brilliant alchemist of dubious morality, whose experiments would turn the stomach of even the most cutthroat criminal. Selling his skills to the highest bidder, he cares little for how his noxious concoctions are used, with the ensuing chaos...

name: Sion
title: The Undead Juggernaut

passive.name: Glory in Death
passive.desc: After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health. His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.

spells.name: Decimating Smash
spells.desc: Sion charges a powerful swing in an area in front of himself that will deal damage to enemies when released. If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.

spells.name: Soul Furnace
spells.desc: Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby. When Sion kills enemies, he passively gains maximum Health.

spells.name: Roar of the Slayer
spells.desc: Sion fires a short range shockwave that damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit. If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back, damaging, slowing, and reducing the Armor of all enemies that it passes through.

spells.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
spells.desc: Sion charges in a direction, ramping up speed over time. He can steer his charge slightly with the mouse cursor location. When he collides with an enemy he deals damage and knocks them up based on the distance he has charged.

blurb: A war hero from a bygone era, Sion was revered in Noxus for choking the life out of a Demacian king with his bare hands—but, denied oblivion, he was resurrected to serve his empire even in death. His indiscriminate slaughter claimed all who stood in his...

name: Sivir
title: the Battle Mistress

passive.name: Fleet of Foot
passive.desc: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.

spells.name: Boomerang Blade
spells.desc: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.

spells.name: Ricochet
spells.desc: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.

spells.name: Spell Shield
spells.desc: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.

spells.name: On The Hunt
spells.desc: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.

blurb: Sivir is a renowned fortune hunter and mercenary captain who plies her trade in the deserts of Shurima. Armed with her legendary jeweled crossblade, she has fought and won countless battles for those who can afford her exorbitant price. Known for her...

name: Skarner
title: the Primordial Sovereign

passive.name: Threads of Vibration
passive.desc: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking. At max stacks of Quaking, enemies take max Health magic damage over its duration.

spells.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
spells.desc: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.

spells.name: Seismic Bastion
spells.desc: Skarner gains a shield and creates an earthquake whose shockwave damages and slows foes.

spells.name: Ixtal's Impact
spells.desc: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.

spells.name: Impale
spells.desc: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions. Once suppressed, the victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around.

blurb: The ancient, colossal brackern Skarner is revered in Ixtal as one of the founding members of its ruling caste, the Yun Tal. Devoted to keeping his nation safe from the rest of the world, Skarner dwells in a chamber beneath Ixaocan where he can hear the...

name: Smolder
title: the Fiery Fledgling

passive.name: Dragon Practice
passive.desc: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice. Stacks increase the damage of Smolders basic Abilities.

spells.name: Super Scorcher Breath
spells.desc: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy. As he gains more stacks, this ability becomes more powerful.

spells.name: Achooo!
spells.desc: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze that explodes when hitting enemy champions.

spells.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
spells.desc: Smolder takes flight ignoring terrain and bombarding the lowest health enemy.

spells.name: MMOOOMMMM!
spells.desc: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.

blurb: Hidden amongst the craggy cliffs of the Noxian frontier, under the watchful eyes of his mother, a young dragon is learning what it means to be heir to the Camavoran imperial dragon lineage. Playful and eager to grow up, Smolder looks for any excuse to...

name: Sona
title: Maven of the Strings

passive.name: Power Chord
passive.desc: Accelerando: Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead. Power Chord: Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.

spells.name: Hymn of Valor
spells.desc: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to two nearby enemies, prioritizing champions and monsters. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone bonus damage on their next attack against enemies.

spells.name: Aria of Perseverance
spells.desc: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, sending out protective melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone a temporary shield.

spells.name: Song of Celerity
spells.desc: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allies bonus Move Speed. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allied champions tagged by the zone bonus Move Speed.

spells.name: Crescendo
spells.desc: Sona plays her ultimate chord, stunning enemy champions and forcing them to dance and dealing magic damage to them.

blurb: Sona is Demacia's foremost virtuoso of the stringed etwahl, speaking only through her graceful chords and vibrant arias. This genteel manner has endeared her to the highborn, though others suspect her spellbinding melodies to actually emanate magic—a...

name: Soraka
title: the Starchild

passive.name: Salvation
passive.desc: Soraka runs faster towards nearby low health allies.

spells.name: Starcall
spells.desc: A star falls from the sky at the target location dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If an enemy champion is hit by Starcall, Soraka recovers Health.

spells.name: Astral Infusion
spells.desc: Soraka sacrifices a portion of her own health to heal another friendly champion.

spells.name: Equinox
spells.desc: Creates a zone at a location that silences all enemies inside. When the zone expires, all enemies still inside are rooted.

spells.name: Wish
spells.desc: Soraka fills her allies with hope, instantly restoring health to herself and all allied champions.

blurb: A wanderer from the celestial dimensions beyond Mount Targon, Soraka gave up her immortality to protect the mortal races from their own more violent instincts. She endeavors to spread the virtues of compassion and mercy to everyone she meets—even...

name: Swain
title: the Noxian Grand General

passive.name: Ravenous Flock
passive.desc: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

spells.name: Death's Hand
spells.desc: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.

spells.name: Vision of Empire
spells.desc: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.

spells.name: Nevermove
spells.desc: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.

spells.name: Demonic Ascension
spells.desc: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.

blurb: Jericho Swain is the visionary ruler of Noxus, an expansionist nation that reveres only strength. Though he was cast down and crippled in the Ionian wars, his left arm severed, he seized control of the empire with ruthless determination… and a new...

name: Sylas
title: the Unshackled

passive.name: Petricite Burst
passive.desc: After casting a spell, Sylas stores a charge of Petricite Burst. Sylas's basic attacks will expend a charge and whirl his energized chains around him dealing bonus magic damage to enemies hit. While Sylas has a charge of Petricite Burst, he gains attack speed.

spells.name: Chain Lash
spells.desc: Sylas lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies. After a delay, magical energy explodes from the intersection point dealing damage.

spells.name: Kingslayer
spells.desc: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.

spells.name: Abscond / Abduct
spells.desc: Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.

spells.name: Hijack
spells.desc: Sylas steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely.

blurb: Raised in one of Demacia's lesser quarters, Sylas of Dregbourne has come to symbolize the darker side of the Great City. As a boy, his ability to root out hidden sorcery caught the attention of the notorious mageseekers, who eventually imprisoned him...

name: Syndra
title: the Dark Sovereign

passive.name: Transcendent
passive.desc: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities. Dark Sphere: Syndra can hold an additional charge Force of Will: Bonus true damage. Scatter the Weak: Increased width and slows all targets Unleashed Power: Executes low health targets

spells.name: Dark Sphere
spells.desc: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.

spells.name: Force of Will
spells.desc: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.

spells.name: Scatter the Weak
spells.desc: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.

spells.name: Unleashed Power
spells.desc: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.

blurb: Syndra is a fearsome Ionian mage with incredible power at her command. As a child, she disturbed the village elders with her reckless and wild magic. She was sent away to be taught greater control, but eventually discovered her supposed mentor was...

name: Tahm Kench
title: The River King

passive.name: An Acquired Taste
passive.desc: Tahm Kench puts the heft of his immense body behind his attacks, gaining extra damage based on his total health. Damaging enemy champions builds stacks of An Acquired Taste. At three stacks, he can use Devour on an enemy champion.

spells.name: Tongue Lash
spells.desc: Tahm Kench lashes out with his tongue, damaging and slowing the first unit hit and healing himself if he strikes an enemy champion. Applies a stack of An Acquired Taste to enemy champions. If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.

spells.name: Abyssal Dive
spells.desc: Dive down and then re-appear at target location, damaging and knocking up all enemies in an area.

spells.name: Thick Skin
spells.desc: Passive: Tahm Kench stores a percent of the damage he takes and heals based on it while out of combat. Active: Convert all stored damage into a temporary shield.

spells.name: Devour
spells.desc: Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds, dealing magic damage if they are an enemy, or shielding them if they are an ally.

blurb: Known by many names throughout history, the demon Tahm Kench travels the waterways of Runeterra, feeding his insatiable appetite with the misery of others. Though he may appear singularly charming and proud, he swaggers through the physical realm like a...

name: Taliyah
title: the Stoneweaver

passive.name: Rock Surfing
passive.desc: Taliyah gains Move Speed near walls.

spells.name: Threaded Volley
spells.desc: Taliyah throws a volley of rocks in a target direction, moving freely as she casts. This creates Worked Ground below her. If Taliyah casts Threaded Volley on Worked Ground, she consumes the ground to throw a stronger boulder that slows enemies.

spells.name: Seismic Shove
spells.desc: Taliyah causes an area of ground to erupt and throws enemies within it in a direction of her choosing.

spells.name: Unraveled Earth
spells.desc: Taliyah creates a slowing minefield. If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.

spells.name: Weaver's Wall
spells.desc: Taliyah creates a very long wall and then surfs it.

blurb: Taliyah is a nomadic mage from Shurima, torn between teenage wonder and adult responsibility. She has crossed nearly all of Valoran on a journey to learn the true nature of her growing powers, though more recently she has returned to protect her tribe...

name: Talon
title: the Blade's Shadow

passive.name: Blade's End
passive.desc: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times. When Talon attacks a champion with 3 stacks of Wound, they bleed for heavy damage over time.

spells.name: Noxian Diplomacy
spells.desc: Talon stabs the target unit. If they are within melee range, this attack deals critical damage. If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them. Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target.

spells.name: Rake
spells.desc: Talon sends out a volley of daggers that then return back to him, dealing physical damage every time it passes through an enemy. The returning blades deal bonus damage and slow units hit.

spells.name: Assassin's Path
spells.desc: Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance. This ability has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown.

spells.name: Shadow Assault
spells.desc: Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed. When Talon emerges from Invisibility, the blades converge on his location. Each time the blades move, Shadow Assault deals physical damage to enemies hit by at least one blade.

blurb: Talon is the knife in the darkness, a merciless killer able to strike without warning and escape before any alarm is raised. He carved out a dangerous reputation on the brutal streets of Noxus, where he was forced to fight, kill, and steal to survive...

name: Taric
title: the Shield of Valoran

passive.name: Bravado
passive.desc: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.

spells.name: Starlight's Touch
spells.desc: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored. Bravado-empowered attacks grant a charge of Starlight's Touch.

spells.name: Bastion
spells.desc: Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion. Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.

spells.name: Dazzle
spells.desc: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.

spells.name: Cosmic Radiance
spells.desc: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.

blurb: Taric is the Aspect of the Protector, wielding incredible power as Runeterra's guardian of life, love, and beauty. Shamed by a dereliction of duty and exiled from his homeland Demacia, Taric ascended Mount Targon to find redemption, only to discover a...

name: Teemo
title: the Swift Scout

passive.name: Guerrilla Warfare
passive.desc: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.

spells.name: Blinding Dart
spells.desc: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.

spells.name: Move Quick
spells.desc: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Teemo can sprint to gain bonus Move Speed that isn't stopped by being struck for a short time.

spells.name: Toxic Shot
spells.desc: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target On-Hit, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.

spells.name: Noxious Trap
spells.desc: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time. If Teemo throws a mushroom onto another mushroom it will bounce, gaining additional range.

blurb: Undeterred by even the most dangerous and threatening of obstacles, Teemo scouts the world with boundless enthusiasm and a cheerful spirit. A yordle with an unwavering sense of morality, he takes pride in following the Bandle Scout's Code, sometimes...

name: Thresh
title: the Chain Warden

passive.name: Damnation
passive.desc: Thresh can harvest the souls of enemies that die near him, permanently granting him Armor and Ability Power.

spells.name: Death Sentence
spells.desc: Thresh binds an enemy in chains and pulls them toward him. Activating this ability a second time pulls Thresh to the enemy.

spells.name: Dark Passage
spells.desc: Thresh throws out a lantern that shields nearby allied Champions from damage. Allies can click the lantern to dash to Thresh.

spells.name: Flay
spells.desc: Thresh's attacks wind up, dealing more damage the longer he waits between attacks. When activated, Thresh sweeps his chain, knocking all enemies hit in the direction of the blow.

spells.name: The Box
spells.desc: A prison of walls that slow and deal damage if broken.

blurb: Sadistic and cunning, Thresh is an ambitious and restless specter of the Shadow Isles. Once the custodian of countless arcane secrets, he was undone by a power greater than life or death, and now sustains himself by tormenting and breaking others with...

name: Tristana
title: the Yordle Gunner
